entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
This appeal has been filed under Section 14-A (2) of the Scheduled Castes & Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 (in short "SC/ST Act") against the order dated 15.01.2025 passed by the Special Judge, Ujjain in Case No.SPST No.121/2022, whereby the application filed by the appellant under Section 483 of B.N.S.S. has been dismissed in connection with FIR/Crime No.276/2022 dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station - Badnagar (AJK), District Ujjain (MP) for commission of offence punishable u/S 376, 376(2)(n) and 506 of IPC alongwith 3(2)(v) and 3(2)(va) of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act and 66-E of the I.T. Act.
2.

entities.text: Scheduled Castes & Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
His first appeal was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 25.01.2023 passed in Cr.A.
No.12642/2022 with liberty to renew his NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:6775 2 CRA-1212-2025 prayer after examination of prosecutrix before the Trial Court.

Thereafter, his second appeal was dismissed on merit vide order dated 17.07.2023 passed in Cr.A. No.5726/2023 and his third appeal was also dismissed on merit vide order dated 30.01.2024 passed in Cr.A.
No.1443/2024.
3.
Looking to the earlier dismissal of appeals on merit, no case for reconsideration of this appeal is made out as there is no change in the circumstances.
